commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner kick, but Adrian reads it well and stops the effort.
90+6' Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Now Rayo Vallecano have a corner.
90+5' Corner kick. Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is ready to send the ball into the box.
90+4' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) steps up to send the ball in.
90+1' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) takes the direct free kick from far out, but his shot flies into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
89' Here comes a substitution. Pep Chavarria is given a rest as he is replaced by Sergio Guardiola (Rayo Vallecano).
88' The game is interrupted. William Carvalho (Betis) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
88' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
87' Pablo Fuertes blows his whistle and it's Cedric Bakambu (Betis) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
87' A pass by Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is out of play. Betis will have a throw-in.
84' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) sends the corner into the box, but Augusto Batalla intercepts it and averts the threat.
84' Antony (Betis) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Betis are awarded a corner kick.
83' Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
82' Inigo Perez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) replacing Pedro Diaz.

81' Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
81' The Betis players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
79' Wonderful movement by Rayo Vallecano. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
77' Manuel Pellegrini prepares a substitution. Cucho Hernandez is replaced by Cedric Bakambu (Betis).
77' The game has come to an end for Pablo Fornals. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of William Carvalho (Betis).

77' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Pablo Fuertes blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Free kick. Rayo Vallecano will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

76' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) was in a good shooting position just outside the box and unleashed a first-time shot towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper made a decent save to thwart his effort.
74' Great save! Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Adrian.
72' Flag up against Antony (Betis). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.

72' What a huge chance for Antony (Betis). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
71' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
70' The attendance is 13480.
69' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Isco will be replaced by Giovani Lo Celso (Betis).
69' That will be all from Abde Ezzalzouli who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jesus Rodriguez (Betis).
69' Antony (Betis) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
68' It is time for a substitution. Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) is on for Pathe Ciss.
68' Inigo Perez has decided to make a change. Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Jorge de Frutos.
67' The referee allows time for a substitution. Ivan Balliu will be replaced by Pacha (Rayo Vallecano).
67' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) sends in a cross from a long-range free kick. However, his effort lacks accuracy and the ball sails off the pitch.
66' A clumsy foul by Antony (Betis) and Pablo Fuertes blows his whistle.
65' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick in order to find one of his teammates. His poor effort, however, sails way out of play.
64' A pass by Aitor Ruibal (Betis) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is behind the touchline and Rayo Vallecano will take a throw-in.
63' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Antony (Betis) took the corner.
62' The ball is cleared after Antony (Betis) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee signals a corner kick to Betis.
61' 2 - 2 Goal! Isco (Betis) puts the ball into the left side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Augusto Batalla.
60' Isco (Betis) is going to take the penalty!
59' Pablo Fuertes blows his whistle after Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Betis are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick!
58' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
58' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball. It will be a corner kick for Rayo Vallecano.

57' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
56' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
55' Isco (Betis) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
53' Natan (Betis) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Pablo Fuertes had an easy-decision to make.

51' 2 - 1 Goal! Cucho Hernandez (Betis) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Augusto Batalla had no chance of reaching it. The score is 2:1.
51' One of the Betis players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
50' Isco (Betis) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
48' Isco (Betis) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Pablo Fuertes who sees an offensive foul.
48' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
47' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
46' Isco (Betis) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
46' Pablo Fuertes blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+7' The end of the first half.

45+6' 2 - 0 Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) struck with a perfectly taken free kick from the edge of the box. He curled the ball straight inside the right post. There are not enough superlatives that can be used to describe that goal.
45+5' Rayo Vallecano are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
45+5' Pablo Fuertes shows a yellow card to Marc Bartra (Betis) for a tough tackle.
45+4' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Pablo Fuertes stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
45+1' Isco (Betis) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
45+1' Isco (Betis) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Betis have a corner.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Pablo Fuertes signals.
44' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
44' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano). Rayo Vallecano force their opponents to concede a corner.
42' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
42' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) is able to continue to play.
39' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
39' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
37' 1 - 0 Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the middle of the goal, and thus alter the score to 1:0.
37' Antony (Betis) blasts the ball high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
36' Isco (Betis) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
36' A poorly taken free kick by Isco (Betis)! He sends a shot from the edge of the box into the defensive wall. Betis force a corner. They send men into the box.
34' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) touches the ball with his hand. Betis have a free kick from a promising distance.
34' Isco (Betis) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
34' Marc Bartra (Betis) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Good work from Betis as they win a corner.
33' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes a short corner kick.
33' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
32' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
31' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

31' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball goes out for a corner. Rayo Vallecano can continue in their attacking effort.

30' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
29' Antony (Betis) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Augusto Batalla, who smothers the ball.
28' Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis) releases Abde Ezzalzouli, who latched on to his perfect through pass and can continue with his team's attack.
27' A pass by Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

26' A precise low pass is received by Antony (Betis), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
25' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Isco (Betis).
25' Youssouf Sabaly is being substituted because of an injury. Manuel Pellegrini sends Aitor Ruibal (Betis) on the pitch.
24' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
24' The game is interrupted now, Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
23' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Betis get a corner.
23' A cross from Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
23' Pablo Fornals (Betis) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
22' Betis seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
20' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Augusto Batalla is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
19' Augusto Batalla steps in and intercepts a long pass from Johnny Cardoso (Betis).

19' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
18' Isco (Betis) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Pablo Fuertes blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
16' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) whips in a cross from the corner, but Adrian is well positioned and punches the ball away.

15' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) elects to shoot from the edge of the box instead of sending the free kick into the box, but the defensive wall manages to block the shot. Wasted opportunity! The linesman makes the right call and Rayo Vallecano will have a corner.

14' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Rayo Vallecano are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
14' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
13' Isco (Betis) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
12' Isco (Betis) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

12' Isco (Betis) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. Betis will take a corner kick.
11' A long pass, executed by Isco (Betis), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
10' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
9' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) was quite harsh and Pablo Fuertes didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
9' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) is penalised for a foul. Pablo Fuertes had a clear view and blows his whistle.
7' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball narrowly wide of the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
6' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
6' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) sends a long ball in, but Adrian comfortably gathers the ball. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Rayo Vallecano.
5' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is about to take a corner kick.
5' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano). Corner kick. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity.
4' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
3' Antony (Betis) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
3' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.

2' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Pablo Fuertes with no other option than to blow for a foul. Betis are awarded the free kick.
